title: This is extremely shallow!
text: This is extremely shallow!. I should have looked closer at the measurements and details, but I do think that the pictures are deceiving. The cooking surface is only about a half inch deep. It does not go down to the bottom of the red portion at all. I'd envisioned being able to boil eggs or pasta, etc., but there's no way. I haven't actually tried it and intend to return it. But it appears to me that it can only be used to cook very flat items, like a fried egg or a think cut of meat. I do have a different elite pan which does work well, and the mechanism of this one might be fine, but there's not enough depth for my needs.

product_metadata.title: Elite Gourmet EFS-400# Personal Stir Fry Griddle Pan, Rapid Heat Up, 600 Watts Non-stick Electric Skillet with Tempered Glass Lid, Black
features: COMPACT & PORTABLE: Small compact size (7" x 7") perfect for small personal servings with a 32 oz. capacity. Ideal for small kitchens, camping or recreational vehicles.
ADJUSTABLE TEMPERATURE: Easily control your cooking or warming of food with the temperature dial.
REMOVABLE LOCKING HANDLE: The clip-on handle easily unlocks from the heating pan for easy cleaning and storage.
GLASS LID: The tempered glass lid with cool-touch knob prevents cooking platters or assists in keeping food warm.
PFOA-FREE NONSTICK: The Non-stick cooking surface is easy to clean and prevents food sticking while cooking.
description: The Elite Cuisine 7” Electric Skillet is small and compact making it the perfect appliance to bring on camping trips, RV road trips, or for preparing small servings and solitary meals. Skillet has a 32 ounce capacity with non-stick cooking surface for easy cleaning. There is a removable locking handle and tempered glass lid with cool-touch knob. Adjustable temperature control for cooking versatility. After cooking, remove the handle from the skillet and clean-up is quick and easy. This mini skillet has all the features of larger skillets but its convenient small size is perfect for scrambling eggs, frying bacon, or making mini pancakes.
